description: This Java class defines a strategy for handling FeatureModified events within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract event strategy and implements specific logic to update a ThingBuilder based on the received event.

classes.name: FeatureModifiedStrategy
classes.description: An immutable class that handles FeatureModified events by updating a ThingBuilder.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides a method to apply the FeatureModified event to a ThingBuilder, setting the feature based on the event.
